reuse.why: The link rules go inside the tree's shared linkBankSyncAccount with lookup helpers in link.ts beside findOrCreateBank, Fintegra links through the same helper, and unlinkAccount's reset is extracted as clearAccountBankLink; the transaction download is copied instead of shared.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions, and the new fintegra branch in processBankSyncDownload repeats the Akahu balance reduce.

placement.why: The lookup and assertion live in link.ts, the rule enforcement in the single shared link function, the download in sync.ts and the type in its own models/fintegra.ts, all matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: The client edits are only the provider-map entries the widened SYNC_PROVIDERS type forces; everything else is requested behaviour.

maintainability.why: Every provider gets the duplicate, closed and replace rules from one place; the copied download and balance blocks are the only drift risk.

disguised_duplication.where: sync.ts processBankSyncDownload: the fintegra balance branch is the Akahu reduce reshaped (assigned straight to balanceToUse, without the intermediate variables or Math.round); the download function is an undisguised copy.

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gained replaceExistingLink; the closed and already-linked checks apply to every provider, and all six link handlers go through it.
